subject: C to D FEM candidate handoff C-CODE-05
body:
TASK: C-CODE-05 FEM lifecycle + compaction crash-safety handoff (CANDIDATE, not VERIFIED)
STATUS: DEV_DONE / CANDIDATE_RTL_READY
FILES (branch_agent_c):
  ref/learning/fem_ref.py                   reference: S11.9 ingress filter, S11.11 lifecycle FSM + saturating counters,
                                            S11.6 commit order, S11.12.3 recovery classification, fault injection B0..B6
  ref/learning/gen_fem_vectors.py           per-boundary expectations -> tb/learning/vectors/fem/fem_expect.hex
  rtl/native_ai/memory/fem_lifecycle.v      Verilog-2001 candidate (single-prototype unit, T2 word port, txn_step B0..B6 observable)
  tb/learning/tb_fem_lifecycle.v            TB with persistent T2 model (survives DUT reset), per-clock invariant monitor,
                                            one power-cut per boundary + CONTROL, REOPEN regression check
  tb/learning/run_fem_local.py              runner (xsim if on PATH else iverilog)
TEST: python tb/learning/run_fem_local.py ; python ref/learning/fem_ref.py
RESULT: FEM_COMPACTION_LOCAL_PASS (ICARUS): CONTROL + B0..B6 all land in exactly one of OLD_VALID/CANDIDATE_NEW/COMMITTED_NEW,
        {raw_present, prototype_committed} never {false,false}, index->prototype never while uncommitted,
        fem_feat after recovery == control, rolled-back runs re-compact to the identical prototype words.
        Recovery map: B0 -> OLD_VALID ; B1,B2 -> CANDIDATE_NEW (discard, raw authoritative) ; B3..B6 -> COMMITTED_NEW (roll forward).
        Mutation control: 5 RTL mutants (index-before-commit, roll-forward-uncommitted, no ingress filter,
        reopen-without-regression, retire-before-commit) all KILLED by the TB. Falsifier-shape mutants in the ref also detected.
        XSim NOT run locally (no Vivado here). Please rerun; runner auto-selects xsim.
FINDING (spec-relevant, additive note added to S11.12.3): repair_skill_id/version must be durable at the RESOLVED transition
        (write-through HDR2 word), else a B0 cut re-commits a prototype that differs from control. First TB run caught it.
CONTRACT NOTES FOR D:
  - T2 model = word-atomic writes, sync read (1-cycle). Real DDR/BRAM atomicity and the multi-prototype table layout are yours.
  - ENGINEERING_TOOL / HOST_INJECT domains are counted and dropped: Vivado/CI/agent failures never enter FEM (S11.9).
  - Encodings (life_state codes, T2 word layout, reason codes) are LOGICAL_STATE_ENCODING_CANDIDATE / LEARNING_LOCAL_LAYOUT_CANDIDATE.
  - FEM emits features/observables only (fem_feat). Not FACT, not ASTRA status, not an action selector (S11.8).
BLOCKER: none for D consumption.
UNRESOLVED AUTHORITY DEPENDENCY: repair 'verified success' signal comes from the S12 skill path; persistent-boundary promotion of
        any T2 field goes through A/B (S04).
NEXT (C): completion audit of C-CODE-01..06; then next READY owned task / mailbox.
